title: SynergyDao
tagline: A community NFT DAO collection to collectively buy, sell, stake and issue collateral on NFTs.
description: We have created a DAO where the community members can create proposals to buy, sell, stake, issue collaterals, and allow real world businesses to use DAO owned NFTs. They can collectively vote on these proposals. Successful proposals are passed automatically, and executed by the DAO.
how_its_made: We have used below technologies react for FE, solidity smart contracts for creating the DAO smart contract, superfluid to return the yields of NFTs staked. We have programmed the main DAO smart contract such that the community members can create proposals and vote on them. The proposals are executed automatically once they pass successfully. We have used openzeppelin ERC721 contracts to implemented the sample flows.
